title: Tesla-powered Triumph Stag
summary: A 1970s grand tourer rebuilt around a Tesla Model S drive unit and fourteen battery modules. I own the electrical chain from component selection to commissioning.
lede: A 1970s British grand tourer rebuilt around a Tesla Model S drive unit, fourteen liquid-cooled battery modules, and a new electrical system. I own that system from component selection through commissioning.
imageAlt: White Triumph Stag in the workshop with its hood raised during the electric conversion
description: Full-vehicle electrical integration of a Tesla-powered Triumph Stag: battery validation, BMS, high-voltage distribution, cooling, motor control, charging and dash.

title: 352.8 V tractive accumulator
summary: The team's first high-voltage battery: 84 packs in six isolated segments, an aluminum shell estimated about 30% lighter than the steel one before it, and the team's first structural-inspection pass.
lede: Aztec Electric Racing's first high-voltage traction battery, researched, packaged, fabricated, wired and documented around Formula SAE requirements. It passed structural inspection, a first for the team.
imageAlt: Completed high-voltage accumulator enclosure on a workshop table
description: Engineering case study of Aztec Electric Racing's first 352.8 V Formula SAE tractive accumulator: enclosure, isolation, segments, controls, service safety and inspection.

title: IAM3D competition drone
summary: An FPV drone built to carry and release a payload on command. I managed the project; the team finished fourth internationally.
lede: A 3D-printed FPV aircraft built for the 2024 ASME IAM3D Challenge. This case study follows its engineering from requirements and trade studies through mechanism design, structural analysis, printing, testing and competition, where the SDSU team finished fourth internationally.
imageAlt: The IAM3D drone on asphalt with one printed guard detached beside it, and team members seated behind it
facts: ASME IAM3D Challenge, EFx at NWTC, Green Bay, WI
description: Engineering case study of SDSU ASME's 2024 IAM3D payload drone: requirements, trade studies, payload mechanism, structural analysis, additive manufacturing, testing and a fourth-place international finish.

title: Powertrain testbench and pedal controls
summary: A functional test platform with electrical, mechanical and hydraulic systems, used to wire, calibrate and troubleshoot before full-vehicle integration.
lede: A functional test platform that joined electrical, mechanical and hydraulic systems so the team could wire, calibrate and troubleshoot a powertrain before it went into a car.
description: Powertrain testbench and pedal-control work for Aztec Electric Racing: inverter calibration, vehicle wiring and driver-interface design.
